Whether you want to shop in world-class malls, enjoy the beaches, or wish to visit Burj Khalifa. This visa gives you ample time to enjoy.

How to Apply for a 30 Days Tourist Visa UAE with Waytransit Travels & Tourism

Waytransit Travels & Tourism will help you get your visa without any hassle and stress. Here is how you can get a 30 Day Tourist Visa UAE in just a few steps:

 Step 1: Submit Your Documents

To begin your visa application, provide the following documents:

  • A scanned copy of your passport (valid for at least six months).
  • A passport-sized photograph with a white background.
  • Proof of return flight tickets (recommended).
  • Hotel booking confirmation or accommodation details.

Step 2: Processing and Approval

Once we have received your document, we will start processing it efficiently. The process will take 2 to 4 days, to make sure you receive your visa with convenience. 

Step 3: Receive Your Visa

Once your visa is approved, we will send your 30 Day Tourist visa UAE visa email. You can print it out and show it on the immigration arrival.
